tools.name: sapling_list_users
tools.description: List employees (profiles) in the Sapling account, with job, location, department, manager and employment status. Filter by status, department, location, manager GUID, employment status, or start-date range. Each result has a guid for sapling_get_user. Sapling API: GET /profiles.

tools.name: sapling_get_user
tools.description: Get one employee's full profile by GUID, including job details tables and custom tables. Sapling API: GET /profiles/{GUID}.

tools.name: sapling_list_fields
tools.description: List the profile fields that the API can read in this Sapling account, with id, name, section and field type. Use it to learn the field names before you read a profile. Sapling API: GET /profiles/fields.

tools.name: sapling_list_tasks
tools.description: List onboarding and HR tasks in the Sapling account. Give owner_email to list the tasks of one person. Sapling API: GET /tasks.
